# Payment Services Agreement

*Illustrative contract text for a fictional company. Not a real agreement and not legal advice.*

**Agreement reference:** BP-2025-07

**Dated:** 1 July 2025

**Between:**

1. **Brightpay** (the "PSP"); and
2. **Fernway**, a marketplace payments company (the "Merchant").

## Background

(A) The PSP provides online card payment services to merchants on blended pricing.

(B) The Merchant operates an online marketplace and wishes to use the PSP's services for card payments made by buyers on that marketplace.

The parties agree as follows.

## 1. Definitions and interpretation

**1.1 Definitions.** In this Agreement the following terms have the following meanings:

- **"Agreement"** means this agreement, including its Schedules, as amended from time to time.
- **"Business Day"** means a day other than a Saturday, a Sunday or a public holiday on which banks are open for general business.
- **"Card Scheme"** means Visa or Mastercard.
- **"Chargeback"** means the reversal of a Successful Transaction initiated by the card issuer under the Card Scheme rules.
- **"Declined or Failed Attempt"** means a Transaction that is declined by the card issuer or fails for technical reasons and is not captured.
- **"EEA Consumer Card"** means a consumer debit or consumer credit card used in a domestic or intra-EEA Transaction.
- **"EEA Consumer Volume"** means the aggregate amount of all Successful Transactions made with EEA Consumer Cards in a calendar month.
- **"Invoice"** means the monthly invoice issued by the PSP under clause 4.1.
- **"Other Card"** means any card that is not an EEA Consumer Card, including every commercial card.
- **"Refund"** means the reversal, at the Merchant's request, of the whole amount of a Successful Transaction.
- **"Successful Transaction"** means a Transaction that is authorised by the card issuer and captured.
- **"Transaction"** means a payment by card to the Merchant submitted to the PSP for authorisation.

**1.2 Interpretation.** (a) Headings do not affect the interpretation of this Agreement. (b) References to clauses and Schedules are to clauses of and Schedules to this Agreement. (c) Unless stated otherwise, every reference to a time, a date or a calendar month is to Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

## 2. Commencement and duration

**2.1 Commencement.** This Agreement takes effect on 1 July 2025 (the "Effective Date") and applies to all Transactions made on or after the Effective Date.

**2.2 Duration.** This Agreement continues for an initial term of twenty-four months from the Effective Date and afterwards until terminated by either party on three months' written notice to the other.

## 3. Service fees

**3.1 Service Fee.** (a) For each Successful Transaction the Merchant shall pay a single all-inclusive service fee (the "Service Fee") made of a percentage of the Transaction amount plus a fixed amount, subject to the volume discount in clause 3.4:

| Card | Percentage of the Transaction amount | Fixed amount per Transaction |
|---|---|---|
| EEA Consumer Cards | 1.40% (one hundred and forty basis points) | EUR 0.25 (twenty-five euro cents) |
| Other Cards (commercial cards, and consumer cards used in inter-regional Transactions) | 2.90% (two hundred and ninety basis points) | EUR 0.25 (twenty-five euro cents) |

(b) The Service Fee includes all interchange, card scheme and processing fees; no other fee is payable on a Successful Transaction.

(c) No Service Fee or other charge is payable for a Declined or Failed Attempt.

**3.2 Currency.** All fees, charges and credits under this Agreement are calculated, invoiced and payable in euro (EUR).

**3.3 Calculation and rounding.** Each fee and each credit is calculated separately for each Transaction and for each fee component, and is rounded to the nearest whole euro cent before fees are aggregated on the Invoice. An amount of exactly half a cent is rounded to the nearest even cent (banker's rounding).

**3.4 Volume discount.** (a) Where the EEA Consumer Volume of a calendar month exceeds EUR 1,500,000.00 (one million five hundred thousand euro), the percentage element of the Service Fee for EEA Consumer Cards is 1.40% (one hundred and forty basis points) on the first EUR 1,500,000.00 of that volume and 1.25% (one hundred and twenty-five basis points) on the part of the EEA Consumer Volume in excess of EUR 1,500,000.00. The reduced rate applies only to that excess, not to the whole volume.

(b) Transactions continue to be charged at the rate in clause 3.1 when they are processed. The difference is credited to the Merchant as a single volume adjustment on the Invoice for that month.

(c) The fixed amount of the Service Fee and the Service Fee for Other Cards are not affected.

## 4. Invoicing and disputes

**4.1 Monthly invoice.** Within ten Business Days after the end of each calendar month the PSP shall issue an Invoice for the fees of that month, together with a statement listing each fee for each Transaction.

**4.2 Payment.** Each Invoice is payable within fourteen days of its date. The PSP may instead deduct the amount of an Invoice from funds it holds for the Merchant, provided the Invoice has been issued first.

**4.3 Disputes.** The Merchant may dispute an Invoice, or any fee or charge shown on it or on the accompanying statement, by written notice given within thirty (30) days after the date of the Invoice. Any amount found to have been overcharged shall be credited on the next Invoice. Fees not disputed within that period are deemed accepted, except in the case of manifest error or fraud.

## 5. Refunds

**5.1 Processing of Refunds.** The Merchant may request a Refund of a Successful Transaction through the PSP's interface. The PSP returns the Transaction amount to the cardholder and debits it from the Merchant's settlement funds.

**5.2 Refund fee.** (a) For each Refund the Merchant shall pay a refund fee of EUR 0.20 (twenty euro cents).

(b) No fee paid on the refunded Transaction, including the Service Fee under clause 3.1, is credited or repaid when a Refund is made.

## 6. Chargebacks

**6.1 Notification.** The PSP shall notify the Merchant of each Chargeback within two Business Days of receiving it from the Card Scheme.

**6.2 Representment.** The Merchant may provide evidence for the PSP to contest a Chargeback under the Card Scheme rules. The outcome of a representment does not affect the fee under clause 6.3.

**6.3 Chargeback fee.** For each Chargeback the Merchant shall pay a chargeback handling fee of EUR 20.00 (twenty euro), whatever the outcome of any representment.

## 7. General

**7.1 Entire agreement.** This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties on its subject matter and supersedes any earlier arrangement.

**7.2 Variation.** No variation of this Agreement is effective unless it is made in writing and signed by or on behalf of both parties, including by an amendment letter from the PSP countersigned by the Merchant. An amendment letter states the date from which it applies.

**7.3 Governing law.** This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Netherlands. The courts of Amsterdam have exclusive jurisdiction.

Signed for and on behalf of **Fernway** (the Merchant):

# Payout and Foreign Exchange Services Agreement

*Illustrative contract text for a fictional company. Not a real agreement and not legal advice.*

**Agreement reference:** KP-2025-09

**Dated:** 1 September 2025

**Between:**

1. **Kestrel Payouts** (the "Provider"); and
2. **Fernway**, a marketplace payments company (the "Customer").

## Background

(A) The Provider executes payouts to bank accounts in several currencies and converts funds between currencies for that purpose.

(B) The Customer pays out marketplace sellers' funds and wishes to use the Provider's services to do so.

The parties agree as follows.

## 1. Definitions and interpretation

**1.1 Definitions.** In this Agreement the following terms have the following meanings:

- **"Agreement"** means this agreement, including its Schedules, as amended from time to time.
- **"Applied Rate"** means the exchange rate actually applied by the Provider to convert euro into the currency of a Payout.
- **"Business Day"** means a day other than a Saturday, a Sunday or a public holiday on which banks are open for general business.
- **"EUR Equivalent"** means the amount of a Payout converted into euro at the Mid Rate for its Execution Hour.
- **"Execution Hour"** means the clock hour (UTC) that contains the Execution Time.
- **"Execution Time"** means the time at which the Provider executes a Payout.
- **"Invoice"** means the monthly invoice issued by the Provider under clause 5.1.
- **"Mid Rate"** means the mid-market exchange rate of a currency pair for a clock hour, as published for that hour in the hourly reference rate series maintained by the Provider and shown on its statements.
- **"Payout"** means a transfer of funds by the Provider from the Customer's account to a bank account nominated by the Customer.
- **"Spread"** means the amount by which the Applied Rate is less favourable to the Customer than the Mid Rate for the Execution Hour, expressed as a percentage of that Mid Rate.

**1.2 Interpretation.** (a) Headings do not affect the interpretation of this Agreement. (b) References to clauses and Schedules are to clauses of and Schedules to this Agreement. (c) Unless stated otherwise, every reference to a time, a date or a calendar month is to Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

## 2. Payout fees

**2.1 SEPA Payouts.** For each Payout in euro executed as a SEPA credit transfer (a "SEPA Payout") the Customer shall pay a fee of EUR 0.20 (twenty euro cents).

**2.2 Faster Payments Payouts.** For each Payout in pounds sterling executed through the UK Faster Payments scheme (a "Faster Payments Payout") the Customer shall pay a fee of EUR 0.30 (thirty euro cents).

**2.3 SWIFT Payouts.** For each Payout executed by international wire transfer through the SWIFT network (a "SWIFT Payout") the Customer shall pay a fee of 0.10% (ten basis points) of the EUR Equivalent of the Payout amount, subject to a minimum of EUR 8.00 (eight euro) and a maximum of EUR 40.00 (forty euro) per Payout.

## 3. Calculation of fees

**3.1 Currency.** All fees, charges and credits under this Agreement are calculated, invoiced and payable in euro (EUR), including fees on Payouts made in other currencies.

**3.2 Calculation and rounding.** Each fee and each credit is calculated separately for each Payout and for each fee component, and is rounded to the nearest whole euro cent before fees are aggregated on the Invoice. An amount of exactly half a cent is rounded up, away from zero.

## 4. Foreign exchange

**4.1 Spread cap.** (a) For each Payout in a currency other than euro the Provider converts the euro debited from the Customer's account at the Applied Rate.

(b) The Spread, measured against the Mid Rate for the Execution Hour of the Payout, shall not exceed the maximum shown below for the Payout currency:

| Payout currency | Maximum Spread |
|---|---|
| pounds sterling (GBP) | 0.40% (forty basis points) |
| US dollars (USD) | 0.40% (forty basis points) |
| Swiss francs (CHF) | 0.40% (forty basis points) |
| Polish zloty (PLN) | 0.90% (ninety basis points) |

(c) Where the Spread exceeds that maximum, the Provider shall refund to the Customer the euro debited in excess of the amount the maximum Spread allows.

**4.2 Rate disclosure.** For each Payout in a currency other than euro the Provider's statement shows the Applied Rate, the start of the hour whose Mid Rate was used and the euro debited.

## 5. Invoicing and disputes

**5.1 Monthly invoice.** Within ten Business Days after the end of each calendar month the Provider shall issue an Invoice for the fees of that month, together with a statement listing each Payout with its fee and the euro debited for it.

**5.2 Payment.** Each Invoice is payable within fourteen days of its date. The Provider may instead deduct the amount of an Invoice from funds it holds for the Customer, provided the Invoice has been issued first.

**5.3 Disputes.** The Customer may dispute an Invoice, or any fee or charge shown on it or on the accompanying statement, by written notice given within forty-five (45) days after the date of the Invoice. Any amount found to have been overcharged shall be credited on the next Invoice. Fees not disputed within that period are deemed accepted, except in the case of manifest error or fraud.

## 6. Commencement and duration

**6.1 Commencement.** This Agreement takes effect on 1 September 2025 (the "Effective Date") and applies to all Payouts executed on or after the Effective Date.

**6.2 Duration.** This Agreement continues for an initial term of twenty-four months from the Effective Date and afterwards until terminated by either party on three months' written notice to the other.

## 7. General

**7.1 Entire agreement.** This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties on its subject matter and supersedes any earlier arrangement.

**7.2 Variation.** No variation of this Agreement is effective unless it is made in writing and signed by or on behalf of both parties, including by an amendment letter from the Provider countersigned by the Customer. An amendment letter states the date from which it applies.

**7.3 Governing law.** This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales. The courts of London have exclusive jurisdiction.

- **"Invoice"** means the monthly invoice issued by the Acquirer under clause 7.1.
- **"Markup"** means the Acquirer's margin payable under clause 4.2.
- **"Monthly Processed Volume"** means the aggregate amount of all Successful Transactions processed by the Acquirer for the Merchant in a calendar month, before deduction of any fee, Refund or Chargeback.
- **"Refund"** means the reversal, at the Merchant's request, of the whole amount of a Successful Transaction.
- **"Scheme Fee"** means the fee charged by a Card Scheme for a Transaction.
- **"Successful Transaction"** means a Transaction that is authorised by the card issuer and captured.
- **"Transaction"** means a payment by card to the Merchant submitted to the Acquirer for authorisation.

**1.2 Interpretation.** (a) Headings do not affect the interpretation of this Agreement. (b) References to clauses and Schedules are to clauses of and Schedules to this Agreement. ## 2. Commencement and duration

**2.1 Commencement.** This Agreement takes effect on 1 July 2025 (the "Effective Date") and applies to all Transactions made on or after the Effective Date.

**2.2 Duration.** This Agreement continues for an initial term of twenty-four months from the Effective Date and afterwards until terminated by either party on three months' written notice to the other.

## 3. Interchange and scheme fees

**3.1 Pass-through fees.** For each Successful Transaction the Merchant shall pay the Interchange Fee and the Scheme Fee actually incurred by the Acquirer, passed through at cost without any margin. The amounts charged shall not exceed those in the interchange and scheme fee reference table designated "interchange_table_v1" and described in Schedule 1 (the "Reference Table"). The Markup under clause 4.2 is payable in addition.

## 4. Acquirer fees

**4.1 Currency.** All fees, charges and credits under this Agreement are calculated, invoiced and payable in euro (EUR).

**4.2 Markup.** (a) For each Successful Transaction the Merchant shall pay a Markup equal to the percentage of the Transaction amount shown below for the band into which the Monthly Processed Volume of the calendar month of the Transaction falls:

|---|---|---|

| 2 | EUR 2,500,000.00 or more but less than EUR 8,000,000.00 | 0.35% (thirty-five basis points) |

**6.1 Chargeback fee.** For each Chargeback the Merchant shall pay a chargeback handling fee of EUR 15.00 (fifteen euro), whatever the outcome of any representment.

**7.1 Monthly invoice.** Within ten Business Days after the end of each calendar month the Acquirer shall issue an Invoice for the fees of that month, together with a statement listing each fee for each Transaction.

Any amount found to have been overcharged shall be credited on the next Invoice. Fees not disputed within that period are deemed accepted, except in the case of manifest error or fraud.

**7.4 Monthly minimum.** If the total Markup under clause 4.2 on the Successful Transactions of a calendar month is less than EUR 2,500.00 (two thousand five hundred euro), the Merchant shall pay the difference as a minimum fee for that month, shown as a separate line on the Invoice. Markup credits on Refunds under clause 5.1 are disregarded for this purpose.

## 8. General

**8.1 Entire agreement.** This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties on its subject matter and supersedes any earlier arrangement.

**8.2 Variation.** No variation of this Agreement is effective unless it is made in writing and signed by or on behalf of both parties, including by an amendment letter from the Acquirer countersigned by the Merchant. An amendment letter states the date from which it applies.

**8.3 Governing law.** This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany. The courts of Frankfurt am Main have exclusive jurisdiction.

The Reference Table "interchange_table_v1" sets out the Interchange Fee and the Scheme Fee by Card Scheme, card type and region. It is maintained by the Acquirer, made available to the Merchant on request and incorporated in this Agreement by reference.
